scoring_justification: Recompute total %Cl 3p per bond from orbital contributions (stronger tier feasible); recompute peak splitting from reported peak energies; structural checks for peak ordering. All from agent raw CSVs.

outputs.description: Computed percent Cl 3p character for each metal-d-based virtual orbital and the total per M-Cl bond (as the 'total' row).
Simulated Cl K-edge pre-edge transition energies, oscillator strengths, and per-peak %Cl 3p character from TD-DFT.

output_contract.notes: The reference check compares the total %Cl 3p per M-Cl bond and the peak energy splittings to the paper's calculated values with a tolerance, and verifies the Ti > Zr > Hf trend and that two peaks are present with peak2 intensity > peak1 intensity.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold targets for total %Cl 3p per bond, trend order, peak splittings derived directly from paper Table 1 calculated columns and Table 2 orbital compositions.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table 1 calculated %Cl 3p per M-Cl bond (20,18,17) and Table 2 total %Cl 3p sums; the precise values (19.6, 18.1, 16.9) are derived from Table 2 (39.2/2, 36.1/2, 33.8/2). Peak splittings (0.90, 1.26, 1.10 eV) taken from paper Table 1 calculated peak splitting column.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied from paper's explicit numerical values in Tables 1 and 2.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported calculated values; not invented.
